caption: The drawing depicts a circular, medallion-like object centered on a plain, off-white background. Within the circle, which is bordered by a rope-like pattern, there is an image of a rooster standing on the ground with its body facing right and its head turned slightly to the left. The rooster, illustrated in shades of brown and dark beige, has detailed tail feathers and a prominent comb and wattle. Surrounding the rooster are several branches with elongated leaves rendered in brown and muted green tones, curving around both its head and body. The entire composition is confined to the central circular area, with ample empty space surrounding it on the paper.
title: Butter Mold
